context: of the veterinarian. The following are suggested dosages, depending on the condition of the animal and the desired response. Adult Cattle - 1 to 2 mL per 100 pounds of body weight. Calves, Swine and Sheep - 5 mL per 100 pounds of body weight. May be repeated as indicated.
